title: UN Comtrade public API: trade in cement clinker (HS 252310), Portland cement (HS 252321, 252329) and other construction materials
note: Machine-read on 11 November 2026 (raw responses cached in 1_Research/data/raw). Ghana clinker imports by reported net weight: 4.78 Mt (2023), 5.91 Mt (2024); mean 5.5 Mt over the five reported years 2019-2024. Ghana has no material domestic clinker production, so apparent clinker use approximates imports. CORRECTION: v0.2 quoted 2.5-2.7 Mt for 2023 from a secondary reading that mixed quantity units; the primary API net weights supersede it.

title: Emission Factors of Construction Materials in Burkina Faso: a cradle-to-gate LCA based on local assumptions
note: Belemsigri et al. Open access, CC BY 4.0. Cradle-to-gate EFs (t CO2/t = kg CO2/kg): aluminium 12.804, paint 2.50, steel 1.970, Portland cement 1.060, ceramic tiles 0.99, flat glass 0.84, bitumen 0.628, asphalt 0.130, timber 0.16, aggregates 0.008, sand 0.0013. West African (import-dependent, carbon-intensive grid) context; used here only as a clearly flagged regional proxy, not a Ghana measurement.

title: Development of a Life Cycle Inventory Database for Environmental Impact Assessment of Construction Materials in Burkina Faso (LOCAL-LCID2)
note: Salou Nouhoun et al. Open access, CC BY 4.0. Cradle-to-gate, SimaPro/ecoinvent adapted to Burkina Faso, pedigree + Monte Carlo. GWP: painted steel/roofing sheet 3.210, aluminium sheet 2.545, concrete block (river sand) 0.1353, cut lateritic brick 0.01351, adobe+4% straw 0.006121 kg CO2e/kg; structural concrete 323, normal 240, lean 159 kg CO2e/m3. Methodological precedent for a developing-country LCI database.

title: Life-cycle assessments of limestone calcined clay cement (LC3): GWP reduction synthesis
note: Peer-reviewed cradle-to-gate GWP reduction of LC3 vs OPC clusters at about 30-40% on a mass basis (Pham 32.9%, Rashid up to 40%, Scrivener/EPFL ~40%); 20-23% at conservative industrial scale; up to ~46-60% with service-life functional units. Corroborates (does not substitute for) the Heidelberg Tema 'up to 40%' company communication.

title: Comparative cradle-to-gate LCA of South African cements
note: Ige & Olanrewaju. Open access, CC BY 4.0. Full text verified: CEM I 0.993, CEM II/B-L 0.856, CEM II/B-V 0.706, CEM III/A 0.641 kg CO2e/kg (SimaPro, ecoinvent 3.8 South African datasets built on five cement companies).

title: Life cycle assessment of a passive vernacular adobe versus fired-brick house, Western Desert, Egypt
note: Dabaieh et al. Green open access, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (numeric values citable as facts; article not redistributable). Fired clay brick ~5,502 kg CO2e per 1000 bricks (~1.8-2.2 kg CO2e/kg), an inefficient heavy-oil/coal Western-Desert-kiln UPPER BOUND; sun-dried adobe ~0.24 kg CO2e/1000 bricks.
